title: ToolCompletedPayload
description: Payload of tool.completed. `output` is a superset of what the Anthropic SDK path already stored, so existing renderers need no change; engine metadata rides in the sibling `output_meta` and never inside `output`.

output.description: String, SDK content-block array, or a platform object carrying a top-level `kind`. Wrapping any of these breaks chart and table detection.

output_meta.description: Engine metadata. Unrecognised keys are kept under engine_details rather than dropped.

fold.description: Fold provenance, nested so it cannot collide with a field the tool reports about itself. Its presence is what marks a record as folded. Records written before this shape put the same fields at the top level alongside model_context_folded: there, a flat result_ref belongs to the fold, and without that marker it belongs to the tool. Either way a top-level result_ref on a record carrying `fold` is the tool's own.
